Gündemi ve hayatı takip eden konu başlıklarının konuşulduğu Zincirleme Reaksiyon, bu hafta yapay zekayı ve yapay zekanın yeni nesil savaşlardaki rolünü ele aldı. Programın konuklarından Suç Araştırmaları Uzmanı Mesut Demirbilek ve Müzisyen Zeynep Mansur, yapay zekanın oluşturduğu riskleri ve kullanım alanlarını değerlendirdi.
Avrupa'da binlerce okula gönderilen bomba tehdidi içerikli e-postalara değinen Mesut Demirbilek, bu tür olayların hibrit savaşların yeni bir aşamasına işaret ettiğini söyledi.
Siber saldırıların artık yalnızca dijital sistemlerle sınırlı kalmadığını belirten Demirbilek, bankalar, uçaklar ve süpermarketlerin soğuk hava depoları gibi kritik alanların da hedef alınabildiğini anlattı.
Yapay zeka destekli saldırıların giderek yaygınlaştığını ifade eden Demirbilek, bu gelişmelerin günlük yaşamı doğrudan etkileyebilecek sonuçlar doğurabileceğini vurguladı.
Yapay zekanın savaşlardaki rolüne de dikkat çeken Demirbilek, “Yapay zeka yeni bir aktör. Yapay zeka hem suç zincirinde yeni bir aktördür hem de savaşlarda yeni bir aktördür” dedi.
Tam otonom silahların oluşturduğu tehlikelere değinen Demirbilek, bu sistemlerin hedef belirleme ve karar verme yeteneklerinin ciddi riskler taşıdığını söyledi. Yapay zeka alanındaki çalışmalarıyla tanınan Geoffrey Hinton'ın uyarılarını da hatırlatan Demirbilek, teknolojinin kontrolsüz gelişiminin insanlık açısından oluşturabileceği tehditlere dikkat çekti.
Yapay zekanın sanat dünyasındaki kullanımına ilişkin konuşan Zeynep Mansur ise teknolojiden kendi çalışmalarında da yararlandığını belirtti. Son 2 klibinde yapay zeka kullandıklarını anlatan Mansur, “Yapay zeka sanata da el attı. Son iki klibimde Yapay zekadan yararlandık ama keşke bu kadar masum ve bu kadar kullanışlı amaçlar için olsa” ifadelerini kullandı.

Ay Yapım bünyesindeki yapay zeka stüdyosu AI Yapım'ın hazırladığı Çukur Vartolu projesi bir festivalde gösterildi. Gösterimde Erkan Kolçak Köstendil'in dijital figürünün yer aldığı görüldü. Oyuncular Sendikası konuyla ilgili kamuoyuna resmi bir bildiri yayımladı. Köstendil de sosyal medyada tepkisini gösterdi.
Kriz, WAIFF isimli festivalde gösterimi yapılan yapay zeka destekli film projesinde ortaya çıktı. Ay Yapım bünyesinde faaliyet gösteren yapay zeka prodüksiyon stüdyosu AI Yapım'ın hazırladığı Çukur Vartolu projesinde, Çukur dizisinde Vartolu Sadettin'i canlandıran Erkan Kolçak Köstendil'in dijital figürü yer aldı. Köstendil'in bu dijital kopyanın oluşturulmasına rızasının bulunmadığı belirtildi.
Oyuncular Sendikası, WAIFF festivalinde gösterilen projede Köstendil'in dijital figürünün yer aldığını tespit ettiklerini ve oyuncunun bu figürün oluşturulmasına rızasının bulunmadığını sendikaya bildirdiğini duyurdu. Sendika, kamuoyuna ve meslektaşlarına yönelik yayımladığı bildiride şu ifadelere yer verdi:
'Her şeyden önce şu gerçeğin altını çizmek isteriz. Sadece bir oyuncunun değil, hiçbir insanın görüntüsü ve sesi kendi açık rızası olmadan dijital ortamda kopyalanamaz ve modellenemez. Hiçbir oyuncunun görüntüsü, sesi ve ayırt edici kişisel özellikleri, geçmişte gerçekleştirdiği bir performansa dayanılarak, iradesi dışında yeni dijital performanslar üretmek amacıyla sınırsız biçimde kullanılamaz. Bir kişinin iradesi dışında dijital kopyasının oluşturulması, hiç gerçekleştirmediği davranışların ve söylemediği sözlerin kendisine atfedilmesi ve bunların ticari amaçlarla kullanılması, kişilik hakları bakımından ciddi hukuki sorunlar doğurduğu gibi icracı haklarımız açısından da hukuka aykırılık teşkil etmektedir.'
Canlandırdığı karakterin dijital bir ikizinin kendisinden habersiz üretilmesine tepki gösteren Köstendil, projede kullanılan görseli kişisel Instagram hesabından paylaştı. Oyuncu paylaşımında şu ifadeleri kullandı:
' Yapay zeka teknolojisi gelişti ne güzel, aferin yaratıcı genç çocuklar sizi. Yalnız ben bunu bir aktöre benzettim, sizce kime benziyor? Yorumlarda buluşalım.'
Köstendil tepkisini sözlü açıklamayla sınırlı tutmadı. Oyuncu, yıllarca başrolünde yer aldığı Çukur dizisine ilişkin geçmiş yıllarda sosyal medya hesabında paylaştığı tüm görsel ve içerikleri profilinden sildi. Oyuncular Sendikası ise bildirisinde Köstendil'in yanında olduklarını ve haklarını korumak adına gerekli tüm adımları atacaklarını kamuoyuna duyurdu. Gelişme, sektörde yapay zeka ve oyuncu hakları konusunda yeni bir hukuki tartışmanın kapısını araladı.

Senin için yemek yemek yalnızca karnını doyurmak değil, gerçek bir keyif meselesi. Herkesin tercih ettiği güvenli seçeneklere yönelmek yerine karakteri olan, iddialı ve kendine özgü lezzetleri seviyorsun. Kokoreç seçmen, güçlü tatlardan korkmadığını ve ne istediğini bildiğini gösteriyor. Bir sokak tezgâhının önünde durduğunda uzun uzun düşünmez, canın ne çekiyorsa onu söylersin. Üstelik yanında bol baharat, biraz acı ve soğuk bir içecek de varsa keyfin tamamdır. Senin hayat anlayışında küçük mutlulukların yeri büyük. Gece acıktığında, arkadaşlarınla dışarı çıktığında veya plansız bir sokak turuna başladığında kendini en mutlu hissettiğin anları yaşayabilirsin. Biraz spontane, biraz iştahlı ve kesinlikle sıradanlıktan uzak birisin. Kokoreç senin için yalnızca bir yemek değil; kendine has bir ritüel.
Senin için lezzetin en güzel hâli, her lokmada biraz daha devam eden bir keyif. Midye dolma seçmen, tek bir şeye bağlı kalmadan küçük küçük mutluluklar biriktirmeyi sevdiğini düşündürüyor. Bir tane yiyip bırakmak yerine tabağın başında zamanın nasıl geçtiğini unutabilirsin. Limonu bol, pirinci tam kıvamında ve baharatı yerinde olacak. Üstelik kaç tane yediğini saymayı da pek sevmiyorsun! Sosyal, meraklı ve anın tadını çıkarmayı bilen bir tarafın var. Arkadaşlarınla sahilde yürümek, bir şeyler atıştırmak, sohbet etmek ve plansızca uzayan akşamlar sana iyi geliyor olabilir. Senin için önemli olan yalnızca ne yediğin değil, o sırada kimlerle olduğun ve nasıl hissettiğin. Midye dolma seçimin, hayatı küçük ama tekrar tekrar yaşamak isteyeceğin anlarla güzelleştirdiğini söylüyor.
Senin için bazı lezzetlerin modası asla geçmez. Islak hamburger seçmen, gösterişten çok tanıdık ve güvenilir tatları sevdiğini anlatıyor. Bol soslu, yumuşacık ekmeği ve kendine özgü kokusuyla bu hamburger senin gözünde sıradan bir atıştırmalık değil. Belki de gece dışarı çıktıktan sonra yenilen o meşhur hamburgerin verdiği mutluluğu hiçbir restoran yemeği veremiyordur. Sen küçük ritüellerine bağlı, anılarla güçlü bağ kuran birisin. Bir şarkı, bir sokak, bir koku veya bir yemek seni yıllar öncesine götürebilir. Çok büyük beklentiler peşinde koşmak yerine bildiğin şeylerin tadını çıkarmayı tercih edersin. Hayatın her zaman kusursuz olmasına gerek yok; bazen iyi bir hamburger, sevdiğin insanlar ve güzel bir akşam bütün sorunları birkaç dakikalığına unutturabilir.
Sen karar vermeyi bilen, fazla uzatmadan istediğini alan birisin. Aç kaldığında seçenekler arasında saatlerce dolaşmak sana göre değil. Doyurucu, lezzetli ve her zaman güvenebileceğin bir tercih ararsın. Döner dürüm tam da bu yüzden senin vazgeçilmezin. İçindeki malzeme dengeli olacak, sosu yerinde olacak ve ilk ısırıkta doğru karar verdiğini anlayacaksın. Günlük hayatında da benzer bir tavrın olabilir. Gereksiz karmaşadan hoşlanmaz, işini kolaylaştıran çözümleri seversin. Ancak bu pratiklik seni keyifsiz veya sıradan biri yapmaz. Aksine, neyin seni mutlu ettiğini bildiğin için enerjini gereksiz seçimlere harcamazsın. Senin için güzel bir gün bazen uzun planlar değil, eline aldığın sıcacık bir dürümle başlar.
Sen hareketli, sosyal ve hayatın içinde olmayı seven birisin. Tantuni seçmen, lezzetin biraz heyecanlı, biraz baharatlı ve bol karakterli olmasını istediğini gösteriyor. İncecik doğranmış et, lavaşın içine yayılan o nefis yağ, limon ve sumaklı soğan... Senin için bunların hepsi bir araya geldiğinde gerçek bir mutluluk ortaya çıkıyor. Üstelik bir porsiyonla yetinmek her zaman kolay olmayabilir. Hayatında da durağanlıktan pek hoşlanmıyorsun. Yeni yerler keşfetmek, arkadaşlarınla buluşmak, bir anda plan yapmak ve günün akışına kendini bırakmak sana iyi geliyor. Biraz sabırsız olabilirsin ama bu sabırsızlık çoğu zaman yaşama duyduğun heyecandan kaynaklanıyor. Tantuni gibi sen de bulunduğun ortama enerji katıyorsun.
Senin için bir yemeğin güzel olması için karmaşık veya gösterişli olması gerekmiyor. Doğru hazırlanmış, malzemesi dengeli ve tadı yerinde bir lahmacun sana yeter. Yanında maydanoz, limon ve bol yeşillik de varsa başka bir şey aramazsın. Lahmacun seçmen, köklü alışkanlıklara değer verdiğini ve basit görünen şeylerdeki ustalığı fark edebildiğini gösteriyor. Senin karakterinde de bu sadelik ve sağlamlık bulunuyor olabilir. İnsan ilişkilerinde samimiyeti, günlük hayatta güvenilirliği ve verdiğin sözlerin arkasında durmayı önemsersin. Her yeni şeye hemen kapılmak yerine önce tanımak ve anlamak istersin. Bir ortamda gösteriş yapanlardan çok, gerçekten iyi olanı sessizce ortaya koyanları seversin. Senin için kalite bazen tek bir iyi lahmacunun içinde saklıdır.
Senin için mutluluk her zaman büyük organizasyonlar veya pahalı deneyimler demek değil. Sabahın erken saatlerinde alınmış sıcak bir simit, yanında çay ve güzel bir manzara bütün gününü güzelleştirebilir. Simit seçmen, gündelik hayatın içindeki küçük güzellikleri fark edebildiğini ve basit şeylerden keyif almayı bildiğini düşündürüyor. Bir şeyi özel yapanın fiyatı değil, sende uyandırdığı his olduğuna inanıyorsun. Sıcakkanlı, uyumlu ve kendi düzenini seven birisin. Bazen tek başına yürüyüş yapmak, sevdiğin bir kafede oturmak veya işe giderken kısa bir mola vermek sana yetebilir. Büyük beklentilerle kendini yormak yerine hayatın akışında küçük mutluluklar bulursun. Simit gibi sen de tanıdık, samimi ve her zaman kendine yer bulabilen birisin.
Senin için en güzel yemeklerden biri, deniz havası eşliğinde yenilen balık ekmektir. Balık ekmek seçmen, lezzeti atmosferiyle birlikte sevdiğini gösteriyor. Bir sahil kenarı, martı sesleri, kalabalık bir iskele ve elinde sıcacık bir sandviç... Senin gözünde bunlar sıradan bir öğünden çok daha fazlası. Bir yere ait hissetmekten ve bulunduğun anın tadını çıkarmaktan hoşlanıyorsun. Özgürlüğüne düşkün, keşfetmeyi seven ve fazla plan yapmadan da mutlu olabilen bir yapın var. Bazen yalnız kalmak, bazen kalabalığın içine karışmak istersin. Ruh hâline göre değişen bu ihtiyaçlarını yadırgamazsın. Senin için hayatın güzelliği biraz da değişiklikte saklı. Aynı sokaktan her geçişinde bile yeni bir şey fark edebilirsin.
Sen tek bir lezzetle yetinmek yerine kendi mutluluğunu kendin oluşturmayı seviyorsun. Kumpir seçmen tesadüf değil; çünkü bu lezzette herkesin kendi damak tadına göre bir şey bulması mümkün. Mısır, zeytin, turşu, sosis, Rus salatası, kaşar... Senin için önemli olan hepsinin bir araya gelerek tam istediğin tabağı oluşturması. Karar vermek biraz zaman alsa da sonunda ortaya çıkan sonuçtan memnun kalırsın. Hayatında da seçenekleri açık tutmayı seviyorsun. Tek bir kalıba girmekten hoşlanmaz, farklı ilgi alanlarını bir arada yaşamaktan keyif alırsın. Bazen kararsız görünsen de aslında seni mutlu eden şeyin çeşitlilik olduğunu biliyorsun. İnsanlara ve deneyimlere karşı meraklısın. Senin dünyanda biraz her şeyden bulunmalı; çünkü hayatın en güzel tarafı farklı tatları bir arada deneyimlemek.
Senin için lezzet demek, bol malzeme ve doğru denge demek. Çiğ köfte dürüm seçmen, baharatlı tatları sevdiğini ve yemeğini kendi istediğin gibi hazırlatmayı önemsediğini gösteriyor. Bol nar ekşisi, limon, marul ve biraz acı... Senin siparişin belli. Bir dürümün içine ne kadar çok lezzet sığarsa o kadar mutlu olabilirsin. Sosyal ortamlarda kolayca iletişim kurabilen, esprili ve enerjik bir tarafın var. İnsanlarla bir arada olmayı seviyorsun ama kendi zevklerinden de kolay kolay vazgeçmiyorsun. Bazen bir şeyi fazla düşünmeden seçer, sonra da kararının tadını çıkarırsın. Senin için keyif almak büyük bir mesele değil; doğru insanlarla, doğru yerde ve sevdiğin lezzetle olmak yeterli.
Sen gösterişli sunumlardan çok gerçek lezzetlere değer veriyorsun. Ekmek arası köfte…

Sinema tarihinin en büyük kült fenomenlerinden biri olan Star Wars, müzayede dünyasında kırılması güç bir rekora daha imza attı.
Heritage Auctions tarafından gerçekleştirilen ve iki oturumda toplamda yaklaşık 8 milyon dolarlık satış hacmine ulaşan Ultimate Star Wars Auction, franchise tarihinin en başarılı bağımsız müzayedesi olarak kayıtlara geçti.
Bu devasa başarının zirvesinde ise doğrudan karanlık tarafa ait olan efsanevi ışın kılıcı yer aldı.
Vader'ın orijinal kılıcı, serinin en unutulmaz sahnelerinden biri olan The Empire Strikes Back filmindeki efsanevi Cloud City yüzleşmesinde ve Vader'ın kimliğinin ortaya çıktığı dönüm noktasında kullanıldı. Aynı zamanda Return of the Jedi filminde de boy gösteren bu silah, orijinal üçlemenin en kritik iki yapımını birbirine bağlıyor.
Heritage İcra Başkan Yardımcısı Joe Maddalena, iki dünya rekorunun aynı günde kırılmasının Star Wars tarihi için olağanüstü bir kutlama olduğunu belirtti.
Darth Vader'ın ışın kılıcı 4.875.000 dolar fiyatla satıldı. Bu rakam, Tom Jung'un A New Hope için hazırladığı orijinal poster tablosunun 3.875.000 dolarlık eski rekorunu tam 1 milyon dolar farkla geride bıraktı.
Eser, Luke Skywalker'ın ışın kılıcı ve kopmuş el efekt riginin Temmuz 2026'da ulaştığı 3.750.000 dolarlık ekran kullanımı rekorunu da tahtından etti.
Heritage Auctions artık bir Star Wars koleksiyon ürünü, ekran kullanımlı prop, orijinal sanat eseri ve çekim miniatürü alanlarında dünya açık artırma rekorlarını elinde tutuyor.
Oturumlar, I. Episode'dan IX. Episode'a kadar sinema serisinin yanı sıra dizi ve yan filmleri kapsayan çok geniş bir materyal grubunu bir araya getirdi. Vader'ın kılıcının başrolü oynadığı müzayedede; aralarında en ünlü Jedi ve Sith'lere ait 28 ek ışın kılıcının bulunduğu, şimdiye kadar halka açık müzayedede bir araya getirilen en geniş ışın kılıcı koleksiyonu sergilendi.
Etkinlikte ayrıca ekran kullanımlı proplar, orijinal konsept çizimleri, imzalı film posterleri, nostaljik Kenner aksiyon figürleri ve 1977 Topps Star Wars serisinin eksiksiz 330 kartlık ultra yüksek dereceli seti de alıcılarla buluştu.

England are three points behind Spain at the top of their Nations League group
Manager Thomas Tuchel will remind England's players of Uefa's anti-racism protocols before Sunday's Nations League fixture against Spain in Madrid.
The match will be England's first in the Spanish capital since a notorious fixture at Real Madrid's Bernabeu stadium in 2004 which was overshadowed by racist chanting aimed at England players.
The Spanish federation was fined last month and ordered to play their next friendly match with a partial stadium closure after fans sang "Islamophobic and xenophobic" chants about Muslims during a game against Egypt.
"We had a same discussion before the Serbia game [in Belgrade in September 2025]," Tuchel said. "There is a protocol in place.
"Maybe we take our five minutes to inform the players about the protocol if there is a precedent [in Madrid]."
European governing body Uefa, the organiser of the Nations League, has a three-step protocol to handle incidents of discrimination inside stadiums, designed to give referees the power to halt matches, and even abandon games if racist behaviour continues.
In the first instance, referees halt the match and request an announcement on the public address system.
Then, if discrimination continues, officials can stop the game for five to 10 minutes and take the players from the field.
If issues continue after the second stoppage, then the game can be abandoned.
"It's important that the players know about the protocol," Tuchel said.
"And then, yeah, we will give our answers if stuff like this happens. Best answers are on the pitch."
England's black players such as Ashley Cole and Rio Ferdinand were subject to racist chanting during the 2004 friendly in Madrid
Sunday's fixture takes place at Atletico Madrid's home, the Metropolitano.
Victory would ensure England win their Nations League group and earn a more favourable quarter-final draw but world champions Spain are unbeaten in 43 matches, including a 3-2 win at Wembley in September.
"It's important that we play with the same mindset that we played at home, and attack them and try to make it a physical game, and try to impose our strength," Tuchel added.
"It [Spain] is a team that has forgotten how to lose, so it requires a top performance first of all, and if we can deliver this performance, it will give us a big boost.
"I think we're there, and I think we're ready to win on Sunday,"

Luis de la Fuente agreed a contract extension in September to stay as Spain boss until 2032
Luis de la Fuente has dismissed concerns over racism in Spanish football before the national team's Uefa Nations League meeting with England in Madrid on Sunday.
Three Lions boss Thomas Tuchel had earlier confirmed he would remind his players of Uefa's anti-racism protocol before the fixture, which will determine who finishes top of League A Group 3.
While he has stressed he didn't expect there to be any incidents, the visit will be England's first to the Spanish capital since a notorious 2004 encounter at the Bernabeu was overshadowed by racist chanting directed at their players.
Spain head coach De la Fuente was asked whether Tuchel's message to his players showed there was still work needed to tackle racism in Spain.
But he responded: "What I'd tell you, and you can tell Thomas, is that in Spain, there's no racism.
"Just like that, crystal clear. Just like in England, there's no racism in Spain. We aren't racist, any of us."
The Spanish Football Federation was fined last month and ordered to partially close a stadium after supporters directed Islamophobic and xenophobic chants towards Muslims during a match against Egypt in Barcelona.
In the domestic game, Real Madrid's Brazilian forward Vinicius Jr has been a vocal anti-racism campaigner after frequently being on the end of racist chanting - and worse. In 2024 three Valencia fans were sentenced to eight months in prison for abusing him at a match.
Uefa operates a three-step protocol, allowing referees to stop matches, take players off the pitch temporarily and, ultimately, abandon a game if discriminatory behaviour continues.
Tuchel said on Friday: "Maybe we take our five minutes to inform the players about the protocol if there is a precedent [in Madrid]. And then, yeah, we will give our answers if stuff like this happens. Best answers are on the pitch."
However, when asked again about his views at a pre-match news conference on Saturday, Tuchel added: "I never talk about racism in Spain.
"I answered politely a question about what happens, I never expect racism. I got asked, 'what will happen if and if and if?'. And I said, 'if it happens, there's a protocol in place'. That's it.
"But my trust is that we have a friendly atmosphere, that we have an atmosphere who is clearly in favour of the Spanish team, and that football does what it does best: brings people together and not divide people."
Midfielder Declan Rice said: "In the past, I've experienced that in Montenegro and Bulgaria and there was a protocol in place that we followed - we came off the pitch. We know exactly where we are as a group on that.
"The times we are in now, 2026, there should never be racism in football. It's shocking we still have it in the game today.
"I don't want to think about if one of our players or their players is racially abused because that would be a horrible mark on football."
Focusing on the match itself, De la Fuente believed both teams are currently at the pinnacle of world football, although he rejected the suggestion one could simply replicate the other's playing style.
Spain were crowned World Cup winners in the summer, while England finished third after losing to Argentina in the semi-finals.
"I prefer the Spanish model. It's very recognisable, the players are perfectly adapted," said De la Fuente. "The English model is very good, but you have to have that type of player. Neither England can play like Spain, nor Spain like England."
He suggested Spain had faced increasingly aggressive opposition as their recent success had raised expectations.
"It's our best moment in a long time," added De la Fuente, whose side also lifted the Euro 2024 title by beating England. "They are all much more aggressive to beat us now than in other times."
He also defended the value of Spanish players, arguing their performances often outweighed their transfer-market prices compared with those in the Premier League.
"Spanish footballers surprise me that, compared to what is paid in England, they are very cheap," he explained. "I see them as better, in my opinion. Everyone in their market can set the prices."
On the fitness of forward Lamine Yamal, he remained cautious over whether the Barcelona teenager would start or how long he could manage.
"We will see if he is a starter, but if he comes out, it's because he's fit to play," said De la Fuente.
Spain test will reveal if Tuchel and England have learned World Cup lessons

Luis de la Fuente has told Thomas Tuchel there is no racism in Spain after the England coach’s admission that he would remind his players of the anti-racism protocol prior to their meeting at the Metropolitano on Sunday night.
This will be the first time the countries play each other in Madrid since some of England’s black players were subjected to racist abuse in a match at the Santiago Bernabéu in 2004 . And although England have returned to Spain three times without incident since then, twice in Seville and once in Alicante, Tuchel was asked on Friday about going back in the buildup to Sunday’s game. The England coach replied that England “will not expect anything [untoward]” but also said: “maybe we take our five minutes to inform the players about the protocol if there is a precedent [in Madrid].”
Asked to respond to those words, and whether Spain still had work to do combating racism after being fined for discriminatory chants about Muslims during a game against Egypt in Barcelona in March, the Spain coach asked for confirmation as to whom they had come from, then said: “I can say the opposite. Tell Thomas there is no racism. As clear as that. Exactly the same as in England. We’re not racists, none of us.”
Tuchel, speaking later on Saturday night, expressed his irritation with the media, accusing journalists of manufacturing a row. “I got asked ‘what will happen if and if and if’, and I said if it happens, we have a protocol in place. That’s it … I never talked about racism in Spain, I answered politely a question about what happens. You create a lot of confusion for absolutely nothing.”
De la Fuente also described Spain versus England as “one of the best games you can see anywhere in the world right now, maybe the best”, and admitted that his team needs to exercise more control than they had been able to do during their 3-2 win at Wembley in September.
Asked to explain how the Premier League could be the richest league in the world and English players command bigger transfer fees than Spaniards despite the national team not winning anything since 1966 while the selección have won two World Cups and three Euros in this century alone, he insisted that it is a mistake to mix price and value.
“There is a song about value and price and it is exactly that,” the Spain coach said. “Someone has to pay it and that’s very welcome but it doesn’t mean it is the real value. I am surprised often when you see the prices paid for our players compared to [the fees] paid in England. I think ‘they’re so cheap’. They [Spanish players] are the best in the world. You can buy a player for half the price of what you pay in England for someone. In that world, in that market, that’s what’s spent. But I’m clear on this: we must not confuse price and value.”
“Between the English model and the Spanish model, I would choose the Spanish model,” De la Fuente added. “It is recognisable and the players have the ability to express it. The English model has developed a lot and I think it is very good. But you have to have the players. We can’t play like them and they can’t play like us.”
“One of the strengths England have is the ability to run into space. When the game is open, they have people who are comfortable with that space and playing that style. Last time against them we lacked control, were unable to have longer periods of possession and impose ourselves more on our opponents.
“In the last two tournaments, England have been third and finalists. I think they are a great team and they have great players. That shows you it is not easy to win. Maybe that should make us appreciate what we’re doing this century: it is marvellous and very difficult. England are always candidates to win everything [nowadays]. Wales suffered a 3-1 defeat to Norway in Oslo despite a spirited performance, as the threat of relegation to the second tier of the Nations League now looms over Craig Bellamy's side.
Wales looked the better side in the first half and had chances to take the lead, most notably through Daniel James on three occasions, before they unravelled after half-time.

David Brooks' sublime chipped finish sparked hopes of a comeback but Haaland's penalty, after Connor Roberts pushed Schjelderup down in the box, punctured the late momentum they had gathered.
Wales can no longer finish above Norway due to their inferior head-to-head record, even if they beat leaders Portugal, but can avoid automatic relegation if they are not one of the two worst teams to finish bottom in tier A.

Thomas Tuchel insisted his words had been "twisted" as questions over anti-racism protocols overshadowed the build-up to England's Nations League showdown in Madrid.
Tuchel was asked after England's win over Croatia on Thursday how he and England would react if racist abuse occurred during Sunday's game against Spain.
The head coach responded by saying he would "maybe take five minutes" to remind his players of the anti-racism protocols. Tuchel also said "we will not expect" any abuse to occur in Madrid.
The game is England's first visit to the Spanish capital since 2004, when the match was marred by racist abuse directed at England's black players.
Spain were also fined and handed a partial stadium closure last month as punishment for Islamophobic chanting in Barcelona during a game against Egypt in March.
Luis de la Fuente was asked on Saturday by a Spanish-based English journalist: "Does the fact we keep talking about this topic demonstrate that Spanish football still has work to do in the fight against racism?"
In response, the Spain boss said: "What I can tell you, and you can pass this on to Thomas, is that there is no racism in Spain. That's how strongly I feel about it.
"There is no racism. Just as in England, there is no racism in Spain. None of us are racist."
Tuchel was then asked by a Spanish journalist about his counterpart's comments, to which he responded: "I was polite enough to ask [sic - answer] a question from your colleagues.
"And you run and ask the other coach, and tell him that I talk about racism in Spain. It's a perfect example of how it works.
"I never talked about racism in Spain. I answered politely a question about what happens. I never expect racism and the dressing room is the most anti-racist place on earth.
"You create a lot of confusion for absolutely nothing. It's a perfect example of how it should not work."
Tuchel then admitted he was "a little upset" by the situation, feeling he had been tricked to "create a lot of confusion for no reason."
When asked if he had a message ahead of the game to send to Spanish fans, he added: "I sent a message but it got twisted. I said I always expect a friendly atmosphere.
"I don't expect racism, nowhere. I am shocked if it happens. It should never happen.
"I am the first person to stand up for these values. I got asked what happens if it happens and I said there are protocols in place.
"Football does what it does best, brings people together - not divides."
England midfielder Declan Rice was also questioned on the topic, where he referenced previous incidents in which the national team had experienced racism.
Montenegro were charged by UEFA in 2019 for racist behaviour after former boss Gareth Southgate confirmed racist chanting was directed at Danny Rose during a 5-1 win.
The 6-0 win against Bulgaria in Sofia in the same year was also stopped on two occasions in the first half due to racist abuse directed at players.
Speaking ahead of facing Spain, Rice said: "In the past, I've experienced that in Montenegro, Bulgaria and there was a protocol in place we followed. We came off the pitch. We know exactly where we are as a group on that.
"The manager hasn't brought that up yet. It wouldn't surprise me if he brings that up tomorrow. But we know where we stand.
"I'm not expecting any of that tomorrow night. This is a beautiful city, great stadium, the players we're playing against we have a lot of respect for. It's set up to be a really good evening and hopefully not a negative one."

Having been unbeaten in Craig Bellamy's first nine games, Wales have only won four of their past 16 matches
It can be easy to get tangled up in the complexities of Nations League permutations and, although Wales still have a few uncertainties to iron out, the picture is becoming clearer for Craig Bellamy's side.
Following their 3-1 defeat in Norway on Saturday, Wales will finish bottom of Group A4 even if they win their final game against reigning champions Portugal on Tuesday.
But that does not mean they will definitely be relegated from the top tier.
Instead, they are almost certain to play one of the teams from League B in a relegation play-off in March.
However, one thing is for sure: As a result of the Norway loss, Wales will not be among the top seeds for Euro 2028 qualifying.
"We wanted to be in pot one. That was the drive," said head coach Bellamy after the defeat in Oslo.
"Some people might say, 'what makes you think you should be in pot one?' But I do.
"Maybe I'm naïve. I see in big parts of that game we can be in pot one. Let's take the good bits from the game, definitely improve on certain moments of the game and just keep pushing."
A point against Portugal would make sure of it, but even if they lose, Wales will most likely end up in a relegation play-off.
Only the two worst-performing sides will be automatically relegated to League B.
With one game left, the other bottom teams in League A - Turkey, the Czech Republic and Serbia - all have no points, whereas Wales have three.
For them to finish among the worst two, they would need to lose to Portugal, and two of the other teams would need to win their final fixture with a significant swing in goal difference.
Wales have a goal difference of -5. Considering Turkey (-10) visit France, Czech Republic (-10) are in Croatia and Serbia (-7) travel to Greece, it would require an unlikely turn of events for Bellamy's men to be automatically relegated.
Wales have conceded eight goals during this Nations League campaign
The relegation play-offs will be held across two legs at the end of March, with the first leg between March 25-27, and the second between March 28-30.
As a League A side, Wales will be seeded and therefore play at home in the second leg.
The draw for the play-offs takes place at Uefa's headquarters in Nyon, Switzerland, on Friday, 20 November.
The sides that finish in the top two of League A's four groups will also discover the quarter-final draw on the same day.
Slovenia, Northern Ireland, Kosovo and Bosnia-Herzegovina are currently all in second place in their groups.
However, Scotland, Ukraine, Austria, the Republic of Ireland and Poland could also be potential opponents.
Wales have scored three goals in five games during this Nations League campaign
All teams finishing third or higher in League A will be named as top seeds for Euro 2028 qualifying.
By missing out, Wales could now be drawn alongside one of Europe's heavyweights in their group.
Spain, France, Italy, Netherlands and Portugal are among the sides already guaranteed pot one seeding for the draw on 6 December in Belfast.
England will also be a top seed, although Thomas Tuchel's men will be kept apart from Wales and the other Euro 2028 co-hosts in qualifying regardless.
When it comes to reaching the Euros, the 12 group winners and eight best-ranked runners-up qualify directly.
For any of the co-hosts who don't make it via that route, there are two automatic spots available. Those will be awarded to the best-ranked between the four nations who haven't qualified directly.
If Wales still haven't made it, there is still the back-up option of the play-offs.
And given play-off places are based on Nations League rankings, Wales are highly likely to already have that safety net.

As Nigeria inches closer to the 2027 polls, the use of artificial intelligence in the electoral process has prompted questions about integrity and institutional readiness. Can Nigerians trust their democratic processes?
Nigeria has just over two months to go until its general election, with incumbent Bola Tinubu running on a ticket focused on combating raging insecurity and resolving the nation's economic crisis . He faces off against former Vice President Atiku Abubakar and senior opposition figure Peter Obi.
The country's electoral body, the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC), recently released its preliminary voter's register, which reportedly is riddled with images believed to have been generated using artificial intelligence (AI) .
Among the telltale signs of AI usage were exaggerated facial features in images and inconsistencies on the electoral registers, such as duplicates of names and even identities of people who since the previous election had died.
The development raises concerns about the body's overall preparedness ahead of the country's upcoming 2027 general election. Instead of making the upcoming vote more transparent by allowing access to its procedures, INEC has come under fire amid broader controversies about the expanding influence of AI in elections across the continent.
To view this video please enable JavaScript, and consider upgrading to a web browser that supports HTML5 video
Joash Amupitan, the chairman of the electoral commission, said the body is now investigating the development, focusing on discrepancies potentially created by AI use.
To this end, he announced the establishment of a dedicated unit to monitor AI-related threats, detect deepfakes and strengthen the integrity of the electoral process, warning that the credibility of the upcoming election could otherwise be under attack.
However, even prior to the proliferation of AI across Africa and the globe, this would not be the first time that Nigeria has found itself in the unfortunate position of having to deal with the circulation of fabricated images , doctored audio and fake videos online. In the run-up to the 2023 election , deepfakes falsely linking candidates to terror-related activities filled social media platforms.
These are often designed to promote certain candidates or to discredit opponents in a bid to influence public perception, which now with the use of AI could create disinformation campaigns of new proportions.
Lois Ugbede, the assistant editor at the factchecking platform DUBAWA, told DW that "based on our monitoring so far, AI-driven disinformation is serious and is becoming commonplace."
"This could influence political discourse and voter behavior ahead of 2027 because we are already seeing parties using inflated crowds to show that they have a large followership or support," she added.
At the same time, rather than influencing the vote in favor of any particular candidate, "the deeper danger is that people may begin to doubt authentic information simply because they know convincing AI-generated fakes are possible," said Akintunde Babatunde, executive director of the Abuja-based Centre for Journalism, Innovation and Development.
"We often focus on the risk of people believing an AI-generated falsehood, but there is another problem where genuine evidence can be dismissed as AI-generated," he noted, citing instances of a lawmaker who recently made inflammatory remarks during a campaign rally — but then claimed the clips were manipulated.
Chibuike Mgbeahuruike, an election consultant at the Centre for Democracy and Development, told DW that apart from the spread of synthetic content online, AI intrusion into the electoral commission's portal could also "undermine its institutional credibility, especially with the low level of confidence that we are already witnessing."
He added, however, that AI itself is not inherently a threat to electoral integrity. The real threat lies in "the absence of effective accountability for its deployment," as innovations in tech increasingly appear to infiltrate governments and their democratic processes.
"Voters must have confidence … that the technology is also transparent, accountable and independently scrutinized, and ultimately subject to human and institutional oversight," said Mgbeahuruike.
Mallam Jibrin Baba Ndace, the director-general of state-owned broadcaster Voice of Nigeria, agrees, urging journalists at a recent conference also to not fall into the trap of believing reports, which later could turn out to be false due to AI manipulation.
He stressed the importance of protection measures and due diligence in news media, with the growing inability of public institutions like INEC to provide impartial information due to the use and influence of AI and other election-related tech.
Beyond AI, Nigeria's electoral processes have undergone various technological shifts over the years in hopes of improving transparency while increasing efficiency.
Electoral authorities first deployed electronic assistance in 2011, when Direct Data Capture Machines were introduced; the devices collect voters' biometrics by scanning fingerprints or capturing facial recognition data with webcams to stop voters from submitting multiple ballots.
Ten years later, a system called the Bimodal Voter Accreditation System (BVAS) was introduced as the new standard, designed to combine fingerprints with facial recognition. However, during the 2023 general election, this voting process was marred by system failures, as poor cell signals delayed these voter accreditation procedures.
However, with INEC tallying more than 103 million Nigerians registered to participate in the coming poll, disinformation, fake news and technological challenges amount to only a few of several concerns pertaining to Nigeria's democracy.
Voter apathy has become a particular concern, especially among the country's youth. The 2023 election recorded the lowest voter turnout since the country's return to democratic rule in 1999, with merely 27% of registered voters going to the polls.

Pragmatic, resolute and gutsy. Sonia Bompastor showed her ruthless side and delivered a tactical masterclass as Chelsea earned a 1-0 win over Manchester City and leapfrogged them at the top of the Women’s Super League.
Lucy Bronze credited fellow full-back Katie McCabe with firing Chelsea up pre-match, having told them they “had to be dogs” in the game, and a dogged performance followed. Sandy Baltimore’s stunning strike in added time at the end of the first half was the difference as the west London side nullified the threat of a team that had scored in each of their preceding 21 games in all competitions, inflicting their first loss of the campaign.
The task for City got even tougher when goalkeeper Ayaka Yamashita received a straight red for clattering into Alyssa Thompson, but despite their numerical disadvantage it was end to end right up until the final whistle.
“It always affects you when you go one player down,” said manager Andrée Jeglertz. “But we handled that and that’s not why we lose the game. I think it’s small details. It’s a tight game, it’s two great football teams, there’s a lot of situations, there’s a lot of battles and they managed to score on their big chance from a great finish. We also have a couple of great opportunities where we don’t manage to score.”
Momentum was with City going into the match after their 5-0 defeat of West Ham the preceding weekend and a 4-1 win against Inter in the Champions League on Tuesday night and they were able to welcome the injured duo Vivianne Miedema and Beth Mead back to the bench to bolster their matchday squad.
At Stamford Bridge the England women’s manager, Sarina Wiegman, the US women’s manager, Emma Hayes, and passionate women’s football advocate and pundit Ian Wright were in the stands. It was a fixture that promised much, and it delivered: the league’s most potent attacks, with Chelsea having scored 28 league goals before this fixture to City’s 27, while Bompastor’s side had the most solid defence, having conceded only five times before kick-off.
Manchester United captain Maya le Tissier marked her 150th appearance for the club with a superb strike in a 2-0 victory over Crystal Palace at the Progress with Unity Stadium. Presented with a framed shirt before kick-off, Le Tissier whipped a low shot from distance into the net in the 18th minute before Elisabeth Terland confirmed United’s win after the hour mark.
United moved up to fourth with the win and they kept hold of the position after Tottenham drew a blank in a goalless draw at home to Everton , whose winless run in the league stretched to five matches. In the day’s late game, Liverpool ended a five-match winless run in the WSL by easing past Brighton 3-0. Press Association
It was a chess match. After a thrillingly frenetic start there was a change for Chelsea just 12 minutes in, with the centre-back Kadeisha Buchanan replaced by Veerle Buurman. There was speculation over whether the withdrawal of the Canadian defender was due to injury and Bompastor unconvincingly claimed it was.
“Yesterday in training, she got a knock to her head during contact with a teammate. She was fine after the training session. She was fine in the evening. We assessed her again this morning and everything was fine,” she said. “I just felt watching her from the beginning of the game, she was not herself. Then I took the responsibility to make the substitution. But for me, I was almost forced to do that because I know my player and I know she was not in the game.”
However, if, as many believe, the defensive switch was a tactical decision, it was a stroke of genius, as Buurman was excellent at nullifying the threat of Khadija Shaw.
“She had a really good performance against a top player,” said Bompastor. “Today was positive. But again, as I’ve told you previously, when it doesn’t work it’s not so positive.”
There were chances at both ends but they were limited and it took until the fourth of five added minutes for Chelsea to draw first blood. The goal was sensational. Baltimore collected the ball just inside the box on the right, from Ellie Carpenter, lined up her shot and sent a piledriver of a strike into the roof of the net.
City sought an instant reply after the break but they could not find a way through and momentum ebbed and flowed. Jeglertz withdrew Sam Coffey and Mary Fowler in favour of Miedema and Laura Blindkilde Brown to help his side assert some authority in the middle and, through Miedema, to add some creative instinct.
However, as City pushed they left themselves vulnerable on the break and when Maika Hamano’s crossfield ball was met by Alyssa Thompson with just over 15 minutes remaining it was disaster for City. Yamashita raced out of her box and clattered into the Chelsea forward, conceding a free-kick and receiving a straight red card.
Despite City’s efforts, Chelsea were in control and they held strong to blow the title race wide open.

In any big encounter you will often hear managers say it is the "fine margins" that decide a game of football.
Sometimes it is luck. Sometimes it is individual brilliance. But on Saturday it was Sonia Bompastor's bold decisions that helped Chelsea beat Manchester City 1-0.
The top-of-the-table Women's Super League clash was as intriguing as you would hope it to be and both managers needed to be on their toes.
Chelsea boss Bompastor "took responsibility" and brought off struggling defender Kadeisha Buchanan 12 minutes in, and it had the desired effect.
City striker Khadija Shaw was not able to get in behind like she had done in the early stages, and Buchanan's replacement Veerle Buurman shone.
When the fourth official's board went up showing the number of the player Buurman would replace, there was confusion from Chelsea players.
It was clearly not planned, nor had Buchanan asked to come off. There was no apparent injury as she jogged off and she was clearly upset, heading straight down the tunnel.
Asked to clarify the situation, Bompastor said: "Yesterday in training she got a knock to her head in contact with a team-mate but she was fine.
"She was fine in the evening and we assessed her again this morning and everything was fine. I had that information before the game.
"But I felt from watching her at the beginning of the game that she was not herself. I took the responsibility to make the substitution.
"I felt I was almost forced to do that. I know my player and she was not in the game."
Whether Buchanan's shaky start was down to that knock is unclear, but Bompastor knew her decision was a risk and was willing to act immediately.
Buurman instantly marshalled Shaw, and City's early threat was quietened as Chelsea regained control and ended the half a goal up thanks to Sandy Baltimore.
Shaw did not record a shot on target and in-form England international Lauren Hemp was quiet as Buurman performed well in a stubborn Chelsea backline.
City manager Andree Jeglertz said he did not think the switch "changed the picture", but he was outsmarted by Bompastor during the 90 minutes.
Bompastor admitted she had not spoken properly with Buchanan at full-time but promised to "explain myself to her".
"I just told her a few words. My assistant coach Camille Abily will have done that already probably and I think everything will be fine," said the Frenchwoman.
"I always have good relationships with the players, bring them clarity, and I'm always direct and honest so they have the information. It won't be any different."
The risky substitution was compounded by an injury to striker Melvine Malard 23 minutes later, meaning Chelsea's XI was tweaked twice before half-time.
Not normally one to bring on players at the break, Bompastor was smart and hooked goalscorer Baltimore, who was likely still buzzing from her impact.
She was replaced by Maika Hamano, who went on to play the ball through to Alyssa Thompson when she was brought down by City goalkeeper Ayaka Yamashita, and she was shown a straight red card as a result, ending the visitors' comeback hopes.
"We knew going into the second half we only had one substitution slot and we knew Sandy has been playing lots of minutes," said Bompastor.
"I knew she probably didn't have the legs to go more than maybe 60 minutes and I knew I didn't have more slots after that. I was forced into this one as well.
"It paid off and that's good. Sandy was doing well but she knows the reason why we made that decision.
"That's the first time I experienced that kind of substitution in the first half. It's good for my own experience."
Bompastor's bravery was rewarded and, while City certainly had their chances, Chelsea defended resiliently to see out the narrow win.
Jeglertz could not find a solution to Chelsea's attacking threats, which came largely from wide areas via Ellie Carpenter and Thompson.
Vivianne Miedema returned from injury and looked sharp when she came on for City in the second half, but it was not enough to change the result.
In contrast, Bompastor's risks proved the difference, and they were made with former Chelsea boss Emma Hayes, who mastered the art of bullish decisions, watching on in the stands alongside Sarina Wiegman at Stamford Bridge.
Chelsea's victory bumped them back up to the WSL summit, a point above City, while Buurman picked up the player-of-the-match award.
"It paid off today. You have to be brave to make that decision in that moment because you know bringing in a player in the game is a risk," said Bompastor.
"We had a good conversation with Veerle and she was clear on why she wasn't starting the game. That clarity was important for when she came in.
"She had a really good performance against a top player. Sometimes when it doesn't work, it's not so positive, but today it was.
"You have to react and be the one that analyses the situation and make decisions. I'm used to it, even if you don't see lots of substitutions in the first half most of the time in football."

Chelsea Women vs Manchester City Women. Barclays Women's Super League.
Report and reaction as Chelsea beat Man City to leapfrog the reigning champions at the top of the Women's Super League table; Sandy Baltimore gave Chelsea a deserved half-time lead; Lauren Hemp missed a sitter in the second half before Ayaka Yamashita's red card for fouling Alyssa Thompson
Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player
Chelsea leapfrogged champions Manchester City at the top of the Women's Super League table with a 1-0 victory at Stamford Bridge thanks to Sandy Baltimore's bullet first-half strike.
City were beaten for the first time this season having been clumsy all day - from a lacklustre first half, to wayward finishing in the second to goalkeeper Ayaka Yamashita's straight red card for a professional foul. The race for the WSL title is on.
Chelsea deserved the points - they were more at it than City on the day. They had the better of the first half with Ellie Carpenter, Melvine Malard and Alyssa Thompson all going close - before Baltimore smashed the Blues in front with a fierce finish from inside the box before half-time.
City have rescued six points from losing positions so far this season but were off colour in their pursuit of a route back.
Their best chance saw Khadija Shaw hook the ball over Hannah Hampton - but Lauren Hemp missed the ball completely from a yard out with the goal empty, with the effort ultimately bouncing wide of the far post.
And City's job was made harder when Yamashita was dismissed for rushing out, missing the ball and bringing down the electric Thompson - which earned her a straight red card. It could have been worse for City but Aggie Beever-Jones' resulting free-kick cannoned off the bar.
The result sees Chelsea move one point ahead of City at the top of the table, while third-placed London City Lionesses could go four points off the summit if they beat Arsenal on Sunday, live on Sky Sports .
4: BIG MISS ! Shaw causes havoc early doors, bursting into the box down the left and finding Aoba Fujino, who fires a huge chance wide of goal.
5: OVER ! Malard does well to hold up a long ball, which falls to Thompson on the edge of the box but she blazes over.
9: WIDE ! Shaw goes on another mazy run, this time down the right - and her cross is deflected just wide of her own goal by Katie McCabe.
10: SAVE ! Malard goes up the other end and her deflected strike is kept out well by Yamashita.
20: BLOCK ! Good work for Thompson sees her square for Carpenter at the back post but her shot is well blocked by Rebecca Knaak, with Malard lurking for a tap-in.
35: BLOW! Malard comes off injured, joining Kadeisha Buchanan as the two Chelsea players to limp off in the first half.
45+4: GOAL! Baltimore gives Chelsea a deserved lead with a stunning strike from just inside the box, before being taken off at half-time.
64: HUGE MISS! Shaw flicks the ball over Hampton but Hemp somehow cannot tap home from a yard out.
70: BIG CHANCE! Carpenter is found at the back post all alone but rushes her finish, which is wildly off target.
72: WIDE! Hemp blazes just over the top corner after being fed down the left wing.
76: RED CARD! City goalkeeper Yamashita rushes out to chase a long ball, but misses her kick and brings down Thompson.
79: OFF THE BAR! Beever-Jones crashes the resulting free-kick off the bar, leaving substitute goalkeeper Eartha Cumings stranded.
90: OVER ! Iman Beney blazes over from a good area after being played through by Beth Mead.
For the first time in 20 matches, Khadija Shaw failed to register a shot on target in a Women's Super League game, dating back to November 2025.
Manchester City's key striker was pretty much a passenger - bar the chip over Hannah Hampton that led to Lauren Hemp missing from a yard out. But Shaw was the victim of some outstanding Chelsea defending.
At the heart of the Chelsea defensive effort was Lucy Bronze, who was everywhere. She won 12 out of her 14 duels - with that dozen duels twice as many as the next-best player on the pitch. In terms of interceptions, she managed seven. The rest of Chelsea's starters only managed five between them.
Another key player to stifle City was Katie McCabe, who had a brilliant all-round game. Only Lexi Potter (9) made more ball recoveries than the Republic of Ireland international on the day, while her long passing up towards Melvine Malard in the first half put City on the back foot.
Sonia Bompastor highlighted the importance of Bronze and McCabe's role in this win. "Having them, they bring a solid performance in terms of the defensive aspect - but they also bring a lot of leadership in the team to help the others around them as well to perform at their best."
Chelsea have the WSL's best defence by a country mile with only five goals conceded from 10 games. They have 10 clean sheets in their last 13 games across all competitions, having played Manchester United, Arsenal, Manchester City and Lyon in that period.
City may have Shaw but Chelsea have the defensive solidity in this WSL title race.
"I know my player," responded Bompastor when questioned on whether the removal of Kadeisha Buchanan after 12 minutes was enforced or tactical. As it turned out the move was a bit of both.
The defender had taken a knock in training the day before. But it also did not go unnoticed how many times Aoba Fujino got in behind Chelsea's backline early in this contest of fine margins.
Bompastor acted without hesitation. Her tactical management of the game throughout was flawless given both Buchanan and Melvine Malard were lost in the first half. She got the better of Andree Jeglertz, whose second-half changes affected the flow of the game but did little to bring prize striker Bunny Shaw into play in better areas.
Chelsea were pragmatic but Bompastor was equally resolute in her decision making. The Frenchwoman asked her side to be ruthless pre-match and mirrored that bravery in her own approach.
Given the pressure of the opposition and consequences of the result, this will go down as one of Chelsea's most tactically complete displays under her.
"It's [an] important [win] in terms of the psychological aspects but also right now we are a team who are dropping points against other opponents.
"So I would be more pleased if we were able to win every single game [against the] top teams and [also] the teams we don't expect at the top.
"So yeah, it's really good and it's a nice feeling to be at the top of the table right now, to be able to have won the games against these top sides.
"But I know we still have a lot of work to be done and it's early on in the season, so many things can happen still."
"It's small details. It's a tight game, it's two great football teams. There's a lot of situations, there's a lot of battles in the game and they managed to score on their big chance from a great finish.
"We have also a couple of great opportunities where we don't manage to score. So it's small details but I think we deserve more than going away from here with no points.
"Of course [the red card] is always affecting when you're getting one player down.I think we were on the way to turn it around a little bit.
"So of course it changed but I also think the players dealt with it in a good way. So even though we were one player down I think we had a couple of great opportunities to score a goal after we were playing."

Fenerbahçe Teknik Direktörü Emre Belözoğlu , sarı-lacivertli takımda kazanma odaklı, net planları olan ve savunma planlarının artacağı bir oyun hedeflediklerini söyledi.
Samandıra 'da bulunan Fenerbahçe Can Bartu Tesisleri'nde sarı-lacivertli ekibin antrenmanından önce basın mensuplarıyla bir araya gelen teknik direktör Belözoğlu, takımdaki değişimden hedeflerine dek birçok soruyu yanıtladı.
Fenerbahçe'de oynatmak istediği oyunla ilgili Belözoğlu, "Kendi kendine oyuncudan oyuna gidecek bir yapı inşa etmemiz gerekiyor. Kazanma odaklı, net planları olan, savunma planlarını artıracağımız bir oyun hedefliyoruz. Bu takım savunma konusunda, dünyanın en güçlü ekiplerinden Liverpool'a bunu yapacağını gösterdi. Dünyanın en küçük takımları bile sert blok antrenmanları yapıyor. Bugün test yaptık, herkes iyi durumda. Fenerbahçe fizik olarak herkesi karşılayabilir. Her şeyin içinde bir planın olduğu oyun uygulamayı hedefliyoruz. Bunun için de çalışıyoruz. İnşallah bu fotoğrafı en kısa sürede herkese izleteceğiz." şeklinde konuştu.
Samandıra'da teknik kadrodan sağlık ekibine dek yaşanan değişimle ilgili soruyu "Olması gerekiyordu." diyerek yanıtlayan Belözoğlu, "Yaşanan değişimin ötesinde bir şey yok. Ben bir ekiple geldim. Samandıra'da değişim gerekiyordu. Gelenler mükemmel, gidenler kötüymüş gibi bir durum yok. Bunu doğru bulmuyorum. Emeği geçen çok kişi var. Tamamen değişimle ilgili bir durum söz konusu. Belirlediğimiz noktalar vardı ve hızlı hareket etmek durumundaydık. Bu bir bayrak yarışı, bunu biz devraldık. Elimizden gelenin fazlasını yapmaya çalışacağız. Değişimin ötesinde başka bir durum yok. Emeği geçenlere teşekkür ediyorum. İnsanların aileleri var, burada değerlendirme yaparken buna dikkat etmek gerekiyor. Gidenler de değerli isimlerdi." ifadelerini kullandı.
Fenerbahçe'de farklı bir futbol oynatmaları gerektiğinin altını çizen Emre Belözoğlu, dünyada atlet futbolcuların önemli hale geldiğini belirtti.
Sarı-lacivertli takımın oynadığı futbol anlamında bir geçmişe sahip olduğunu vurgulayan Belözoğlu, "Fenerbahçe'de oyunun genetiği var. Büyük bir camia beklentisi var. Fenerbahçe'nin oyunu için de gerekenleri söylemiştim, kalite ve tutku. Bazı maçlarda işin içine akıl girecek. Bazı maçlarda farklı kelimeler olacak. Bunun olmazsa olmazı kalite. Ne kadar hızlanacağımızı göreceğiz. Ümidim bunu hızlı yapmak. Başlangıcımız fena olmadı. Ama tek çiçekle bahar gelmiyor, bunun suni olmamasını arzu ediyorum." açıklamasını yaptı.
Şu anda gündemlerinin ilk oynanacak Kocaelispor maçı olduğunun altını çizen Belözoğlu, "Gündemimiz ocakta yapacağımız hamleler ve takımın eksikleri değil. Fenerbahçe'nin net bir gücü var. İdmanda hissediyorum, oyuncuyla konuşunca hissediyorum, ilk oynadığımız maçta hissettim. Bugün gündemimiz hamle ve Trabzonspor maçı değil. Gündemimiz tamamen Kocaelispor maçı, sonra Shakhtar maçı olacak. Ciddi şekilde takıma merhem olacak organizasyonu inşa etmemiz gerekiyor. Zamanı geldiğinde değerlendirmeler yapmamız gerekiyor. Milli takım arası oldu, bu bir avantaj. Bazı oyuncular milli takımlara çağrılmadı, onlara ufak dokunuşlarımız olacak. Fenerbahçe'de başarı kriteri performanstır. Kocaelispor maçına kadar takımı ne kadar hazırlayabilirim, bunun derdindeyim." diye konuştu.
Emre Belözoğlu, Fenerbahçe'de en büyük arzusunun, altyapıdan yetişen oyunculara şans vermek olduğunu dile getirdi.
Daha önce sarı-lacivertli kulüpte önce sportif direktörlük ardından da teknik adamlık yaptığını hatırlatan Belözoğlu, "O dönemde oynattığımız genç isimler oldu. Bu, büyük bir hedef. Ama gerçekçi bakmak lazım, elimizdeki en iyi ve en güçlü kadroyla sahaya çıkmamız gerekiyor. Yiğit Efe Demir şu anda en değerli oyuncularımızdan biri. Hem lig hem de Avrupa tecrübesi var. Genç ve tecrübeli bir oyuncudan bahsediyoruz. Her futbolcuya ihtiyacımız var." dedi.
Daha önce basın toplantısında kullandığı "Mahremiyet" kelimesiyle ilgili konuşan Belözoğlu, şunları söyledi:
"Oyuncunun burayı özel bilmesi gerekiyor. Takımı etkilemeyecek şeyler olması gerekiyor. Suni gündemle takıma zarar verecek durumu ortadan kaldırmalıyız. Fenerbahçe 'nin herkesi değerli kıldığının bilinmesi gerekiyor. Burada taktik antrenman hazırlığı oluyor. Oyuncu bunu gördüğü zaman bir hazırlık olduğunu bilmeli. Burada özel kalması gereken yerler var. Mahremiyetten kastım biraz da oyuncunun bunu bilmesiydi. Bunun kontrolünün olması lazım. Oyuncuyu motive etmek istediğim yer burası. Bu sebeple dışarıdaki evlerle bağlantıyı kesmemiz gerekiyor. Özelimiz olmalı."

Declan Rice has confirmed he is close to signing a new contract with Arsenal .
BBC Sport first revealed the midfielder was set to sign a new long-term deal at Emirates Stadium on 7 October, and the 27-year-old, speaking before England's game against Spain on Sunday, said: "A new contract is hopefully on the horizon soon and I'm extremely lucky to be at a club like Arsenal where the manager shows me so much trust and team-mates who put so much energy in to me."
Rice's current deal expires in 2028 but the former West Ham star is now expected to extended his tenure in north London, having arrived from London Stadium in 2023 in a deal worth £105m.
The midfielder's new contract will put him alongside Bukayo Saka as Arsenal 's top earner.
Rice has managed to avoid upheaval during his career and he believes that continuity has helped him to blossom.
"I've been extremely lucky I've managed to play at such a consistent level throughout my career. I always set myself targets, pushing for more," he said.
"I'm extremely Iucky not to have to worry about that stuff as it makes playing football far more easier."

texts.https://www.skysports.com/football/manch:
Manchester United Women vs Crystal Palace Women. Barclays Women's Super League.
Manchester United beat Crystal Palace 2-0 with goals from Maya Le Tissier and Elisabeth Terland; Eva Olid's side were on top throughout the contest but just three shots on target from their 22 efforts meant battling Palace stayed in the game; United up to fourth in WSL; Palace 11th
Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player
Maya Le Tissier marked her 150th club appearance with a stunning strike as Manchester United moved fourth in the WSL with a dominant 2-0 win over Crystal Palace.
Le Tissier cracked in the opening goal from around 25 yards out to give United the lead during a first half they spent almost entirely on the front foot.
Battling Palace made it trickier for their hosts after the break but were undone too easily for the second, when Hinata Miyazawa and Jess Park combined to play in Elisabeth Terland for a clinical finish.
United will feel they should have taken more from a game which saw them rack up 22 shots but hit the target just three times, with Lea Schuller wastefully lobbing wide late on.
The win was never in doubt, though, with goal-scorer Le Tissier repeatedly snuffing out counter-attacks from a Palace side who failed to test United goalkeeper Phallon Tullis-Joyce at all.
With United on the rise ahead of the later kick-offs, Palace stay 11th.

Belirlediğimiz noktalar vardı ve hızlı hareket etmek durumundaydık. Bu bir bayrak yarışı, bunu biz devraldık. Elimizden gelenin fazlasını yapmaya çalışacağız. Değişimin ötesinde başka bir durum yok. Emeği geçenlere teşekkür ediyorum. İnsanların aileleri var, burada değerlendirme yaparken buna dikkat etmek gerekiyor. Gidenler de değerli isimlerdi." ifadelerini kullandı.
Fenerbahçe'de farklı bir futbol oynatmaları gerektiğinin altını çizen Emre Belözoğlu, dünyada atlet futbolcuların önemli hale geldiğini belirtti.
Sarı-lacivertli takımın oynadığı futbol anlamında bir geçmişe sahip olduğunu vurgulayan Belözoğlu, "Fenerbahçe'de oyunun genetiği var. Büyük bir camia beklentisi var. Fenerbahçe'nin oyunu için de gerekenleri söylemiştim, kalite ve tutku. Bazı maçlarda işin içine akıl girecek. Bazı maçlarda farklı kelimeler olacak. Bunun olmazsa olmazı kalite. Ne kadar hızlanacağımızı göreceğiz. Ümidim bunu hızlı yapmak. Başlangıcımız fena olmadı. Ama tek çiçekle bahar gelmiyor, bunun suni olmamasını arzu ediyorum." açıklamasını yaptı.
Şu anda gündemlerinin ilk oynanacak Kocaelispor maçı olduğunun altını çizen Belözoğlu, "Gündemimiz ocakta yapacağımız hamleler ve takımın eksikleri değil. Fenerbahçe'nin net bir gücü var. İdmanda hissediyorum, oyuncuyla konuşunca hissediyorum, ilk oynadığımız maçta hissettim. Bugün gündemimiz hamle ve Trabzonspor maçı değil. Gündemimiz tamamen Kocaelispor maçı, sonra Shakhtar maçı olacak. Ciddi şekilde takıma merhem olacak organizasyonu inşa etmemiz gerekiyor. Zamanı geldiğinde değerlendirmeler yapmamız gerekiyor. Milli takım arası oldu, bu bir avantaj. Bazı oyuncular milli takımlara çağrılmadı, onlara ufak dokunuşlarımız olacak. Fenerbahçe'de başarı kriteri performanstır. Kocaelispor maçına kadar takımı ne kadar hazırlayabilirim, bunun derdindeyim." diye konuştu.
Emre Belözoğlu, Fenerbahçe'de en büyük arzusunun, altyapıdan yetişen oyunculara şans vermek olduğunu dile getirdi.
Daha önce sarı-lacivertli kulüpte önce sportif direktörlük ardından da teknik adamlık yaptığını hatırlatan Belözoğlu, "O dönemde oynattığımız genç isimler oldu. Bu, büyük bir hedef. Ama gerçekçi bakmak lazım, elimizdeki en iyi ve en güçlü kadroyla sahaya çıkmamız gerekiyor. Yiğit Efe Demir şu anda en değerli oyuncularımızdan biri. Hem lig hem de Avrupa tecrübesi var. Genç ve tecrübeli bir oyuncudan bahsediyoruz. Her futbolcuya ihtiyacımız var." dedi.
Daha önce basın toplantısında kullandığı "Mahremiyet" kelimesiyle ilgili konuşan Belözoğlu, şunları söyledi:
"Oyuncunun burayı özel bilmesi gerekiyor. Takımı etkilemeyecek şeyler olması gerekiyor. Suni gündemle takıma zarar verecek durumu ortadan kaldırmalıyız. Fenerbahçe'nin herkesi değerli kıldığının bilinmesi gerekiyor. Burada taktik antrenman hazırlığı oluyor. Oyuncu bunu gördüğü zaman bir hazırlık olduğunu bilmeli. Burada özel kalması gereken yerler var. Mahremiyetten kastım biraz da oyuncunun bunu bilmesiydi. Bunun kontrolünün olması lazım. Oyuncuyu motive etmek istediğim yer burası. Bu sebeple dışarıdaki evlerle bağlantıyı kesmemiz gerekiyor. Özelimiz olmalı."

Türk sinemasına ilk Altın Ayı ödülünü getiren 1963 yapımı "Susuz Yaz" filminin başrol oyuncusu Hülya Koçyiğit, filmin 63 yıl sonra dizi olarak çekilen yeni uyarlamasında aynı karakteri canlandıran Lizge Cömert ile Antalya'da bir araya geldi.
Buluşma, Antalya'da süren COP31 İklim Zirvesi kapsamında filmin özel gösteriminin ardından yapılan söyleşide gerçekleşti. Metin Erksan'ın yönettiği filmde Bahar'ı oynayan Koçyiğit, sete konservatuvar öğrencisiyken geldiğini anlatarak "Ben oyuncu olmaya çok erken yaşta karar verdim" dedi. Filmin gerçek olaylardan esinlendiğini belirten usta oyuncu, "Hikayemiz gerçek olaylara dayanıyor. İzmir Urla'daki Bademler Köyü'nde geçiyor" ifadelerini kullandı.
DHA'ya konuşan Koçyiğit, Ay Yapım imzalı yeni dizinin Kanal D'de yayımlanacak olmasından duyduğu heyecanı şu sözlerle anlattı: "Günümüzde Kanal D'de yakında yayınlanmaya başlayacak Susuz Yaz dizisi beni çok heyecanlandırdı. Ben de baştan sona izleyeceğim. Merakla bekliyorum."
Söyleşinin ardından kuliste Lizge Cömert ile görüşen Koçyiğit, genç oyuncuya başarı diledi. Koçyiğit, "Filmi izleyen çok insan merak edecek ve izleyecek. Genç arkadaşlarımın görevi bize nazaran zor. Hep mukayese edilecekler. Başaracaklarına inanıyorum" dedi.
Çekimleri Adana'da süren dizide Bahar'a hayat veren Cömert ise "Ortak bir hikayeyi farklı şekilde yorumlayacağız. Çok heyecanlıyım, izledikten sonra düşüncenizi çok merak ediyorum" diye konuştu. İki oyuncu sohbetin sonunda birlikte hatıra fotoğrafı çektirdi.

Raphinha was sent off as Brazil crashed to a 3-2 defeat to Japan in their international friendly in Singapore. The Barcelona captain had been substituted after 71 minutes, but was shown a red card after protesting against Tatsuhiro Sakamoto’s stoppage-time winner on the touchline. The Brazil head coach, Carlo Ancelotti, was also sent off in a fractious ending to the match.
Japan went 2-0 up inside 20 minutes through Takefusa Kubo and Keito Nakamura. Vinicius Junior reduced the deficit in the 33rd minute and scored again to drag them level on 75 minutes, before Sakamoto’s controversial late winner.
Argentina ’s post-Messi era began with a 2-1 defeat at home against Uruguay in Buenos Aires. The loss marked the World Cup finalists’ first match since Lionel Messi’s international retirement in early October.
Leonardo Balerdi opened the scoring with an own goal in the 48th minute, before Maximiliano Araújo doubled Uruguay’s lead in the 53rd minute under their new coach, Diego Forlán. Julián Álvarez pulled one back for the hosts in the 73rd minute.
This clásico rioplatense on Friday also kicked off a new chapter for Argentina under Lionel Scaloni, who extended his contract through 2030 this week.
Messi’s retirement remains a fresh wound for local fans; notably, the La Bombonera stadium fell short of a sellout, a rare departure from the norm. While most supporters in the stands wore the albiceleste jersey with Messi’s No 10, Scaloni chose not to assign the number for the match. The coach explained he has yet to select a successor and as it is not mandatory he prefers to leave the jersey vacant for now.
On the pitch, Argentina lacked the explosive, incisive spark Messi typically produced in the final third. Neither Nicolás Paz nor Thiago Almada was able to fill that void. Argentina will hope to bounce back against Costa Rica in Córdoba on Tuesday, while Uruguay host the Dominican Republic on the same day.

Clara Luvanga scored her second goal of the postseason in the 57th minute, capitalizing on an errant pass as the Washington Spirit reached their fifth NWSL Championship and third straight with a 2-1 semi-final victory over the Utah Royals on Saturday.
Luvanga raced on to Nuria Rábano’s ill-advised ball after it rolled past Utah center-back Tatumn Milazzo, then chipped it delicately over the advancing goalkeeper Mandy McGlynn for the winner.
It was her fourth goal in all competitions since her September transfer from Saudi club Al-Nassr.
“We didn’t have too much time to work with her, but she’s doing amazing,” Washington coach Adrián González said. “Learning so quick. Knowing what the team needs from her and what this league demands.”
Luvanga also played a crucial pass to create Sofia Cantore’s eighth-minute equalizer for the No 3-seeded Spirit, who will seek their second championship on home turf after being awarded hosting rights in June.
Washington, who won the 2021 title, will face either top-seeded Gotham FC or the fourth-seeded Kansas City Current, who meet in the other semi-final on Sunday.
“Hopefully it’s third time lucky,” Spirit goalkeeper Sandy MacIver said. “I think that we’re more motivated than ever, and the fact that we’ve got this game here at Audi [Field], we couldn’t ask for a better venue.”
Luvanga’s contributions made up for her hesitation on Cloé Lacasse’s second-minute opener from a corner kick for Utah. Luvanga and MacIver both failed to react as Lacasse’s inswinging delivery sneaked in at the near post.
It was the fastest goal in NWSL playoff history and the second of Utah’s first postseason appearance.
Luvanga made amends six minutes later, playing a diagonal ball to release Trinity Rodman down the left. Rodman drove in a low cross toward the near corner of the six-yard box, and Cantore arrived ahead of her defender for a first-time finish.
If the Spirit face Gotham FC in the championship match, it would be a rematch of Gotham’s 1-0 victory in the 2025 NWSL final in San Jose, California.

Declan Rice has admitted he had an “average” World Cup at the end of a gruelling season and needed time out during the international window in September and October in order to return stronger.
The Arsenal midfielder believes the break has served its purpose, having produced starring performances against Bayern Munich and Liverpool in recent weeks . He is now ready to hit his best level for England in Sunday’s Nations League showdown against Spain at the Metropolitano Stadium.
Rice managed nerve pain in a hamstring that affected his lower back throughout the second half of last season and his fitness was a talking point during the World Cup. The 27-year-old had good games, most notably against the Democratic Republic of the Congo in the last 32 when he filled in towards the end as an emergency right-back.
Rice played well and scored in the third-place playoff against France . But he was typically honest when asked to reflect on his tournament as he prepared for the Spain game. England will leapfrog the world champions and finish top of their Nations League group if – and only if – they win in Madrid. It would theoretically bring an easier draw for the two-leg quarter-finals in March.
“By my standards it was an average World Cup,” Rice said. “France was probably my best game, Congo I played really well; some of the other games I didn’t play too well but you look back … I played 69 games [in the season].
“A title win with Arsenal, a Champions League final loss and into a World Cup. It’s annoying because at the World Cup you want to be at your best, you want to be totally fresh, you want to be ready. It’s annoying that I couldn’t perform how I did at Arsenal towards the back end of the season.
“But knowing if I’m not going to be at my best, just constantly give 100% for this team, for the badge and you could see that. I loved [the last-16 win in] Mexico. We had the disappointment of Argentina in the semi-final, the second group game against Ghana. It’s games you look back on and think: ‘Could I have done better?’”
The playoff against France was on 18 July. After a short break, Rice reported back to Arsenal and played 45 minutes of the Community Shield against Manchester City on 16 August. When he played the 90 minutes of the defeat at Brighton on 19 September, he “did not feel right at all”, leading to a conversation with Tuchel who stood him down from England’s first four Nations League ties, the first of which was the 3-2 loss against Spain at Wembley. Rice sent a voice note to the England captain, Harry Kane, to explain his absence.
“I had an honest conversation with the boss here [Tuchel], who was really understanding,” Rice said. “He said: ‘Take some time, get yourself ready.’ It was about using that time to come back fitter and stronger. I feel really good now. It’s still like I’m building up to being 100 per cent but it’s closer to that than what I was a few weeks ago, for sure. And over the last few weeks, my performances have picked up.”
Rice, who won his 81st cap in the win over Croatia at Wembley on Thursday, had only previously withdrawn from three England camps. “I know the importance of playing for England, I know the importance of showing up, being available,” he said. “It’s one of the biggest things to me. Last camp, if I didn’t speak to the manager about it, I wouldn’t have done it. But he gave me his word. So I was in a better place mentally knowing that he authorised it.”
Rice has played at least 50 club matches in each of the past five seasons. “It’s something my body has got used to,” he said. “Probably last year, I felt it more than anything in terms of the amount of games, the toll it does take and realising as you get older, you have to take the recovery side of it a lot more seriously. When you were 21, 22, 23 … you could get up and have a round of golf the next day [after a match]. Now, even though I’m young at 27, you get up after a game and you can hardly feel your legs.”
Meanwhile, Tuchel has decided to start James Trafford in goal against Spain – an eye-catching decision that will only harden the impression that Jordan Pickford is no longer his first-choice goalkeeper. Tuchel gave them two matches apiece in the September/ October window and said that he was minded to split the minutes once again this time.
When he started Pickford against Croatia, it felt as though he had shelved the plan, given his insistence that the Everton player remained his No1 and Spain is plainly the bigger game. But Tuchel announced at his pre-match conference that Trafford would be given the opportunity.
“Traff will play,” Tuchel said. “We want to see how far Traff is. So he gets a highly competitive match. We had some changes in the back four in the last match [against Croatia], so we went for more stability and more experience with Pickers. And Traff gets the match tomorrow.
“Hopefully he’s not too over-excited or overly nervous because there’s no need to be. We trust him. But it is different to play for England than to play for your club. And to have the opportunity to play matches where it really matters is the best way to show up and to show that you’re ready. We know what Jordan can do for us. Jordan is, at the moment, our No1. I have a very clear picture in high-pressure moments.”
Tuchel also revealed that Ezri Konsa was back in contention after missing the Croatia game with a minor knee problem. He made it sound as though the Arsenal defender would start. “He showed up yesterday for individual work and he showed up today for training,” Tuchel said. “Ezri is back and ready to play.”

A Milli Futbol Takımı Teknik Direktörü Sergen Yalçın, UEFA Uluslar Ligi'nde Fransa deplasmanı öncesinde kadro ve oyun planına ilişkin açıklamalarda bulundu. Yalçın, Bordeaux'da oynanacak karşılaşmada hem oyuncu hem de oyun düzeninde değişikliğe gideceklerini söyledi. Milli Takım , A Ligi 1. Grup'taki son maçında 15 Kasım Pazar günü Türkiye saatiyle 22.45'te Fransa ile karşılaşacak ve mücadele ATV 'den canlı yayınlanacak.
Sakatlıktan yeni dönen oyuncuların bulunduğunu belirten Yalçın, Fransa karşılaşmasında hem oyuncu hem de format değişikliğine gideceklerini açıkladı. Deplasmandaki mücadele Bordeaux'daki Stade Matmut Atlantique'te oynanacak. Yalçın bu plana ilişkin şu ifadeleri kullandı:
'Bazen oyuncu, bazen de format değişikliğine gidiyoruz. Fransa maçında da 5-6 oyuncu değişikliği yapacağız ve farklı bir formatta oynayacağız.'
Forvetsiz bir oyun tercih edip etmeyecekleri sorulan Yalçın, planın daha kontrollü bir oyun üzerine kurulu olduğunu vurguladı. Fransa 'nın çok güçlü bir rakip olduğunu hatırlatan teknik direktör , savunma güvenliğini öne çıkardı. Yalçın'ın bu konudaki yanıtı şöyle:
'Yok, olmaz. Forvetsiz oynama gibi bir niyetimiz yok. Ama yarınki maçta biraz daha kontrollü oynayacağız. Arka planı biraz daha sağlam tutmaya çalışacağız. Çok güçlü bir takımla karşı karşıya geleceğiz. Umarım bizim için iyi olur.'
Belçika karşılaşmasını da değerlendiren Yalçın, takımın zaman zaman iyi ve baskılı oynadığını, ikinci hatta üçüncü golü bulabileceklerini ancak bunu başaramadıklarını söyledi. Bu maçlarda oyuncuları değerlendirmeleri gerektiğini vurgulayan teknik direktör , süreci şöyle anlattı:
'Ben aslında bu karşılaşmaları hazırlık maçları gibi görüyorum. Ufak ufak dokunuşlarla bundan sonraki sürecin hazırlığını yapıyoruz.'
Gruptaki durumu değerlendiren Yalçın, göreve yeni geldiklerini hatırlatarak şu sözleri sarf etti:
'Sadece Belçika maçında ben vardım, diğer maçlarda yoktum. Bunu aklınızda tutun, bir kenara yazın.'
Yalçın, takımın toparlanacağına inandığını belirterek sözlerini şöyle sürdürdü:
'Grupta sağlıklı bir durumda değiliz bunun hepimiz farkındayız. Biz daha yeni geldik. Bundan önceki hasarlı durumda biz yoktuk. Bunun toparlanacağını da lütfen bilelim. Bu durum böyle gitmeyecek. Biraz sabır, biraz zaman lazım.'

İdmanı, Türkiye Futbol Federasyonu (TFF) Başkanı İbrahim Hacıosmanoğlu ve TFF yöneticileri de takip etti.
